message.content:
You are implementing Task 7 of a 9-task visual redesign of a static vanilla-JS website (BusinessServices). Tasks 3-6 built css/components.css up through the card layer. Your task APPENDS the portfolio + prices + about layer. Task 8 appends the final layer after you. This is the largest layer in the plan — two Steps, both of which must be appended.

Working directory: c:\Users\leont\Desktop\CleaningSystem-main
Git branch: redesign/warm-premium (already checked out — commit here, do not switch branches)

READ THIS FIRST — it is your requirements, with the exact CSS to use verbatim:
.superpowers/sdd/2026-08-28-cleaning-site-redesign/task-7-brief.md

THIS IS A TRANSCRIPTION TASK. The brief's Step 1 (portfolio, before/after, comparison modal) and Step 2 (prices, about) contain the complete, final CSS. Copy both character-for-character. Do not improve, reformat, reorder, rename, or "fix" any value.

WHAT TO DO:
APPEND the brief's Step 1 CSS block, then the brief's Step 2 CSS block, to the END of css/components.css, in that order. Do not modify, reorder, or delete anything already in the file — the layers from Tasks 3, 4, 5 and 6 must remain exactly as they are. Append only.

CRITICAL — DEDUPLICATION IS THE POINT. The stylesheet being replaced declared `.portfolio-card` and `.portfolio-grid` TWICE each, with contradictory values. The brief declares each exactly ONCE. Do not reintroduce a second declaration of either, and do not write `!important` anywhere.

CRITICAL — DO NOT BREAK THE COMPARISON SLIDER. js/pages/portfolio.js mutates three inline styles at runtime: `#portfolio-modal` display (none→flex on card click), `.before-img` width, and `.slider-handle` left (both set by updateSlider). Your CSS must not fight them:
- `.portfolio-modal` must NOT set `display` — the brief sets only `align-items`/`justify-content`/`position`/`inset`/`z-index`/`padding`, so the inline `display` controls visibility. If you add `display: flex` to `.portfolio-modal`, the modal will be permanently visible over every page. Do not add it.
- `.before-img` must NOT set `width`, and `.slider-handle` must NOT set `left`. The brief correctly omits both. Do not add them.
Transcribe exactly and this is handled for you.

CONTEXT FROM EARLIER TASKS that the brief cannot know:
- All custom properties you reference are already defined in the :root block at the top of the file. Do not redefine any of them.
- These class hooks were added to the markup in Task 2 and this layer is what styles them: `.portfolio-before-after-section`, `.portfolio-ba-title`, `.portfolio-ba-grid`, `.portfolio-ba-card`, `.card-images-preview`, `.preview-half`, `.img-label`. Their spelling is fixed — a typo produces a silently unstyled element.
- `.btn-primary` was styled in Task 5. This task adds `.price-card .btn-primary { width: 100% }` only — that is a scoped override, which is correct and intended. Do not restyle `.btn-primary` itself.
- `.portfolio-card` is reused by the About page markup (`js/pages/about.js` renders `<div class="portfolio-card">`), which is why the brief includes `.page-about .portfolio-card` overrides that cancel the hover lift. That reuse is intentional — do not "fix" it.
- js/components/header.js, footer.js and serviceCard.js were DELETED in Task 2 (dead duplicates). js/components/index.js is the only component file.

GLOBAL CONSTRAINTS (bind every task; violating any fails the task):
1. No content text changes. Do not touch any .js file.
2. No structural changes. Do not touch index.html.
3. `frontend/` is a stale duplicate tree with its own css/. Do not read from it, do not write to it.
6. Token values are exact — character-for-character from the brief.

SCOPE: modify ONLY css/components.css, and only by appending. Nothing else.

EXPECTED OUTCOME — correct, do not "fix": after this task the contact form, focus rings, reduced-motion block and responsive media queries are still missing. Those are Task 8. Do NOT add any rule that is not in the brief, however obviously "missing" it looks.

ENVIRONMENT: NO node, npm, npx, or headless browser (python 3.14 only; command is `python`, NOT `python3`). Do not attempt browser verification, do not install anything, do not claim a browser check passed. The brief's Step 3 asks you to open the modal and drag the slider — IMPOSSIBLE here. Report Step 3 as DEFERRED to the controller's final visual pass.

REQUIRED STATIC VERIFICATION (run these, paste real output into your report):
  grep -c "!important" css/components.css                       → 0
  grep -c "^\.portfolio-card {" css/components.css              → 1   (declared exactly once)
  grep -c "^\.portfolio-grid" css/components.css                → 1
  grep -c "^\.price-card {" css/components.css                  → 1
  grep -n "^\.portfolio-modal {" css/components.css             → present
  sed -n '/^\.portfolio-modal {/,/}/p' css/components.css       → must NOT contain a `display:` declaration
  sed -n '/^\.before-img {/,/}/p' css/components.css            → must NOT contain a `width:` declaration
  sed -n '/^\.slider-handle {/,/}/p' css/components.css         → must NOT contain a `left:` declaration
  grep -c "img-label" css/components.css                        → 1
  grep -c "portfolio-ba-title\|portfolio-ba-grid\|portfolio-ba-card" css/components.css   → 3
  grep -c "page-about" css/components.css                       → 4
  grep -c -- "--ink:" css/components.css                        → 1   (:root not duplicated)
  grep -c "^header {" css/components.css                        → 1   (Task 4 survived)
  grep -c "^\.feature-badge {" css/components.css               → 1   (Task 6 survived)
  awk '{o+=gsub(/{/,"{"); c+=gsub(/}/,"}")} END{print o, c}' css/components.css   → the two numbers must be EQUAL
  git status --short                                             → only css/components.css
Also confirm the file still begins with the "BusinessServices — Design System" banner and the :root block (i.e. you appended, not overwrote).

COMMIT: one commit on the current branch. Use:
  git -c user.email=leontachyan@gmail.com -c user.name=leont commit -m "style: add portfolio, prices and about layer"

REPORT: write your full report to
.superpowers/sdd/2026-08-28-cleaning-site-redesign/task-7-report.md
covering: what you appended, the verification commands with real output, what you deferred and why, and any concerns.

Then return ONLY this short contract as your final message:
- STATUS: DONE | DONE_WITH_CONCERNS | NEEDS_CONTEXT | BLOCKED
- COMMITS: <short sha(s)>
- VERIFICATION: one line summarising the static checks
- CONCERNS: one line, or "none"
